text:
marta: Quick heads-up — I noticed two issues when running the node + python sample apps together: 1) Node SDK logs default to INFO while Python defaults to WARNING, which hides lots of SDK debug lines. 2) OpenTelemetry hook ordering causes the request-id to sometimes not be attached to trace spans (appears missing downstream).

ajohnson: ugh that explains some of the noisy alerts i saw. can you paste a tiny repro?

marta: repro steps: clone repo, run sample-apps/side-by-side, set envs: 
```
REDWOOD_SDK_LOG_LEVEL=debug REDWOOD_OTEL_ENABLED=true ./run-samples.sh
```
Logs (snippet):
```
[2027-03-12T14:02:11.123Z] INFO  client: sending request path=/v1/generate headers={"x-request-id":"req-abc-123"}
[2027-03-12T14:02:11.456Z] WARNING python-sdk: retrying request (no req-id in span)
```
Notice python log warns but trace span lacks the request id.

sam: hmm is the redaction hook running before otel inject? iirc we have a redaction middleware that scrubs sensitive headers and it might be removing x-request-id for some languages because the regex is too greedy.

olivia: right — the regex in redaction-config.json was updated to "/token|authorization|api[-_]?key/i" but someone added a broader strip rule in python that uses `re.sub(r'(?i)(key|id)=(\w+)', 'REDACTED', s)` which accidentally matches `request-id=...`.

marta: exact. i attached the diff in the sample-app PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/423 — the python middleware has `strip_query_params` util.

ajohnson: thanks. two fixes then: 1) unify default log level across SDKs (devex decision), 2) change hook ordering so OTEL inject runs after redaction OR make redaction aware of request-id header names.

telemetry-bot: Automated test suggestion: add an end-to-end that starts both SDKs, sends one request with X-Request-Id, and asserts traces include the header value in span attributes. If missing, fail.

sam: +1 on tests. for immediate patch i can: a) adjust python regex to be whitelist-based for headers (only strip auth-related ones), b) bump python default log level to INFO to match node.

marta: that'd be great. one more thing: the node SDK's OTEL hook registers at `init()` while python registers at `import time` which changes timing; we should standardize to `init()` to avoid racey ordering during app startup.

ajohnson: filed a tiny RFC in our devex-docs repo: https://go/rex-devex/rfc/otel-hook-lifecycle. it proposes `init()` registration + explicit ordering list.

olivia: i can take the regex change + add the request-id whitelist to redaction. assigning to @sam for the log-level parity and @marta to validate samples.

marta: thanks — i'll iterate on the sample-app and add the e2e test. tagging @telemetry-bot to ensure we add the trace assertion to CI. :thumbsup:

ajohnson: sounds good. leaving a note to backport to 1.x SDK branches after the PRs land.

sam: working on PR now, will post link when ready.

marta: awesome, thanks everyone. if i don't post updates here ping me tomorrow.
